Straight answers

Questions you might have.

Will anything go live without us seeing it?

No. You see every page and post first, and nothing goes out until you say yes.

Does this touch our website build?

The pages sit on movelogistics.com. We hand your developer the finished page and the small fixes, or work with them directly, whichever suits.

Why does AI matter for a warehouse?

More buyers now ask AI tools which warehouse to use. They name the businesses they see confirmed in several trusted places. The rings put MOVe in those places.

Can this cover the other warehousing sites?

Yes. Highbrook is the first page. Jarvis Way, Tauranga, Hastings, Nelson, Blenheim and Rolleston can each get one the same way.

How will we know it is working?

A week after each ring we ask AI and Google again, and your monthly report shows what changed.
